# **💼 Work Experience**

<hr class="section-line">

### **Statistical Consultant**

[Statistical Consulting Service](https://science.sjp.ac.lk/sta/scs-usj/) Department of Statistics, University of Sri Jayewardenepura\
*May 2026 - present*

-   Provided statistical consultation for the research project, ***"Opportunities, Challenges, and Constraints Associated with Bivalve Aquaculture Development in Northern Sri Lanka: Socio-economic and Environmental Aspects"***, including data management, statistical analysis, and interpretation of results.

-   Conducted statistical analysis of GPS collar tracking data for an elephant movement study in collaboration with the [Department of Wildlife Conservation](https://www.dwc.gov.lk/) through spatial and temporal data analysis.

-   Assisted researchers in selecting appropriate statistical methods, data visualization, and interpretation of findings for research publications.\
